# Polaris Kernel

> High-fidelity mathematical knowledge infrastructure for humans and AI agents.

## Core Purpose
Polaris Kernel is a structured repository of mathematics based on the Bourbaki pillars. It aims to provide an atomic, semantic, and illustrated knowledge base optimized for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and autonomous software engineering. The content is interactively rendered via Quarto.

## Architecture
- Root: `src/` (6 Pillars of Mathematics, documented in `src/README.md`)
- Technical Docs: `docs/` (Architecture, Typst/Quarto guides, documented in `docs/README.md`)
- Metadata & Datasets: `metadata/` (MSC2020 taxonomy, DLMF datasets in `metadata/DLMF_data/`, documented in `metadata/README.md`)
- Orchestration: `scripts/` (Build system, assets generation, translation tools, documented in `scripts/README.md`)
- Adjacency Rule: Every `.qmd` has a `.json` metadata counterpart in the same folder.
- Governance: Validated via JSON Schemas in `metadata/schemas/`.

## Key Files for AI Agents
- `AGENTS.md`: Global standards and naming conventions.
- `ARQUITECTURE.md`: Deep technical design and segmentation rules.
- `GEMINI.md`: Specific behavioral guidelines for LLMs.
- `docs/README.md`: Index of technical specifications and rendering guides.
- `metadata/README.md`: Overview of MSC2020 and DLMF NIST datasets.
- `scripts/README.md`: Map of automation and processing scripts.
- `GENERATED_ASSETS.md`: Registry of all SVG graphics.

## Technology Stack
- Documentation: Quarto Markdown (`.qmd`, UTF-8).
- Math: LaTeX / Typst formulas.
- Graphics: Python/Matplotlib (SVG) + interactive code execution.
- Quality: Ruff, Mypy, Pytest, Jsonschema.

## Quick Navigation
- Fundamentals: `src/01_fundamentos_logica/`
- Algebra: `src/02_estructuras_algebraicas/`
- Analysis: `src/03_analisis_continuidad/`
- Geometry: `src/04_espacio_forma/`
- Discrete Math: `src/05_discrecion_computacion/`
- Stochastic: `src/06_estocastica_incertidumbre/`
